'''Raharra Lapti''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]].<ref name="Conviction" />

==Biography==
Raharra was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|Youngling]] brought to [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] to help seal an agreement between the anti-[[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] movements and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. She was one of four Jedi assigned to a post on Klatooine until the anti-slavery rebels achieved their independence, the other three being [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyp Durron]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Sothais Saar]], and [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|Jedi Apprentice]] [[Bandy Geffer]].
